Economopoulos was hired as the sixth head coach in Mercer women’s soccer history on Feb. 22, 2012. As a head coach, he is 135-124-36 (.519) at two institutions in Mercer and Georgia Southwestern.\u003Cbr />\r\n\u003Cbr />\r\nIn his 12 seasons in charge, Econompoulos has mentored numerous players that have received both athletic and academic accolades.
